### The Joy of Being Heard
Author: Karrilee Aggett
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/the-joy-of-being-heard-bible-study-minute-may-4-2018.html
Passage: Jeremiah 33:3
Points:
- Exhaustion and life transitions can make prayer feel daunting and silent.
- God extends a direct invitation to approach Him in honest conversation.
- The Lord gives an unwavering promise that He hears and responds.
- Calling out to God reveals wondrous insights beyond human wisdom.
- Knowing God personally answers revitalizes a weary believer's prayer life.

### A Prayer to Boldly Ask God for What Seems Impossible
Author: Rachel Britton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-boldly-ask-god-for-what-seems-impossible.html
Passage: Jeremiah 33:3
Points:
- Difficult circumstances often lead the mind to dwell on worst-case outcomes.
- God gave hope of complete restoration even amid siege and severe destruction.
- People often pray small, cautious prayers by limiting God to human capability.
- Jeremiah 33:3 invites believers to expect answers far exceeding what they imagine.
- Bold prayer rests on God’s boundless power to restore ruins into joy.
